The '''''Transactions of the American Mathematical Society''''' is a monthly [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] of pure and applied [[mathematics]] published by the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Transactions of the American Mathematical Society {{!}} JSTOR |url=https://www.jstor.org/journal/tranamermathsoci |access-date=2024-12-08 |website=www.jstor.org |language=en}}</ref> It was established in 1900. As a requirement, all articles must be more than 15 printed pages. Its ISSN number is 0002-9947.<ref>{{Cite web |title=ISSN 0002-9947 (Print) {{!}} Transactions of the American Mathematical Society {{!}} The ISSN Portal |url=https://portal.issn.org/resource/ISSN/0002-9947 |access-date=2024-12-08 |website=portal.issn.org}}</ref>
